verdict.rationale: Canonical's own marketing pages say Ubuntu Desktop users can get up to 15 years of security coverage through Ubuntu Pro Desktop, which is free for personal use, so the core of the story is delivered. The evidence comes only from marketing copy, though. missing for 10: documented steps for enabling or attaching Ubuntu Pro on an installation, details on which packages and releases the extended coverage includes, and independent or hands-on confirmation that enabling it works.
